driver: test-backend-ops test -b CUDA0 -o SSM_SCAN -p 'd_state=16,head_dim=1,'. The -p filter (added by us; the record's driver is the unfiltered '-o SSM_SCAN') selects exactly one case, SSM_SCAN(type=f32,d_state=16,head_dim=1,n_head=1024,n_group=1,n_seq_tokens=32,n_seqs=4,xbc_overlap=0), the Mamba-1 case that runs ssm_scan_f32<128,16,0> <<<(4 seqs, 8), 128 threads>>> once (L = 32 tokens, L_template = 0). Without the filter the run also executes three Mamba-2/Falcon-H1/overlap cases (d_state 128/256) on the ssm_scan_f32_group kernel, which is not part of this target; drop the -p argument in target.sh (T_PARAMS) to get the record's exact driver.
